title: Bound on the sum of rows
statement: Let $a,b$ be finite bit strings and let $j,p$ be nonnegative integers. For each position $q$ in $a$, take the row sum formed from the bit of $a$ at $q$ and $b$, at indices $j,p+q$, treating a missing bit as $0$. The sum of these row sums is at most the length of $a$.
